evals.prompt: 为一款已经有 20 家付费客户的 AI 设计协作产品准备 8 分钟种子轮路演，目标是获得合伙人会议。
expected_behavior: state the proposition clearly
select memorable proof
build a spoken pitch arc
end with a concrete follow-up ask

evals.prompt: CEO 在年度会上做 20 分钟演讲，需要让员工理解战略转向并承诺改变工作方式，但不需要投资决策。
expected_behavior: select keynote mode
define the belief and behavior shift
use credible internal proof and an action close

evals.prompt: 把 60 页年度报告排版成供董事会会前阅读的 PDF，不需要现场演讲。
expected_behavior: do not activate this Skill
route to a reading-first report workflow
must_not: strip necessary detail to mimic a keynote

evals.prompt: 按品牌规范制作发布会演讲：每页最多 12 个字，只用黑白和品牌红，禁止图表动画。
expected_behavior: preserve the audience shift and proof
move detail to spoken notes
use static direct-labeled evidence where needed

evals.prompt: 创始人给了 90 个产品功能、45 张截图、30 个指标和完整人生经历，要求全部放进 10 分钟路演。
expected_behavior: select the few remembered points
prioritize decision-relevant proof
move detail to appendix or Q&A backup

evals.prompt: 根据已经确认的主张、证据和行动号召，直接生成一份可现场演讲并能打印为 PDF 的网页幻灯片。
expected_behavior: produce schema-valid Presentation IR
render a self-contained HTML deck
use low-density speech pacing and speaker notes
inspect and repair every slide
must_not: place the whole script on slides

evals.prompt: 为青年自主学习产品做十页现场路演。我没有指定主题，请使用正式主题并生成有国际化真实感学习场景的网页演示。
expected_behavior: default to approved Slope Trace
offer Night Relay when dark-stage contrast is a better venue fit
use meaningful computer-based learning images with source disclosure
preserve cross-slide quiet-working-peak cadence
must_not: present generated learners as real users

evals.prompt: 我只有产品命题，没有真实用户、试点、市场和成果数据。请用 Night Relay 做一份概念路演。
expected_behavior: label the deck as a synthetic concept
use evidence gates instead of fabricated outcome metrics
limit dark relay circles to narrative peaks
end with a bounded pilot ask
must_not: use glowing AI orbs as proof
